mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at City Hall and a First Quarter moon. If you are an early bird, look for the space station to pass halfway up the sky from Belleville toward Fitchburg at 4:09 AM tomorrow. Overnight, we will dip down to 58 degrees with no rain predicted.

City Hall is currently focused on the extensive Mark Drive reconstruction project, which is moving through its second phase, alongside ongoing street pavement rehabilitation projects across the city designed to keep our infrastructure safe and accessible.

We have a busy schedule today with the farmer's market at Hometown Junction, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and music at Paddy Mac. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School and more trivia at Hop Haus.
In our weekly police report, on Friday, August 15, a 29-year-old local man was arrested for a second offence O W I after a report of reckless driving was called in by a citizen.
Today's flavor is the delightful Double Strawberry. Culver's is currently closed, but they open tomorrow at 10 AM, when they will be serving Chocolate Heath Crunch.
